then, still kinematics: symmetry discovery · canonicalize (quotient) · discovered-group EMLP path · arena-admissibility guard · enabled/disable contracts · nonlinear-symmetry fallback
redundancy reduction (preprocessing): the symmetry group removes EXACT redundancy; the effective dimension (participation ratio) removes approximate data-dependent redundancy → project to top PCs
one --preset flag configures the whole stack (explicit flags override)
a cross-cutting configuration — each preset sets layers across kinematics, degrees-of-freedom and observables at once
select_size — priced width & depth, chosen in-line before training
also: kernel size from correlation length ξ · angular order from data · spectral-mode budget (operator) · significance-gated depth extension

svg.text: one primitive mixture per layer, trained with the weights; α is DERIVED as the outer Gibbs measure of a free energy on the simplex. Training options: equivariant_realization (emlp / scalable) · auto_epoch early-stop.
Read-outs — deploy the architecture, then price & interpret it
DARTS; per-layer arg max of α
one compact network + its own explanation
fuse λ log n into charge
AllGraph(device=“auto”) · auto = CUDA > MPS > CPU · per-contract MPS-vs-CPU routing (prefer_cpu_on_mps)
pinned to CPU on MPS (launch / scatter-bound):
stay on the MPS GPU (matmul / conv-bound):
spatial · operator (on CUDA: everything on GPU)

The four stages form a causal chain — each stage’s input is the previous stage’s output, so the order cannot be permuted. The MDL action J = R + μ · Ω is not a stage but the single functional minimised at every rung.
Every complexity charge Ω is a DERIVED code length, not a hand-set constant. Read-outs are corollaries of the trained model and never alter the selection.
